family: One fixed total charged-header language in family.py and engine.py PolyPlan/PolyEngine. At large actual length N, the first L=ceil(log2 N) bits encode S-1; EVERY scale1<=S<=2^L is evaluated by the same algorithm. A rejected large plan outputs zero; finite small cutoff lengths use the fixed legacy evaluator. Parameters are exactly k=P2(S^15 L^28 z^7),h=e=P2(S L^3),ell=P2(S^3 L^6 z^3),eprime=P2(S^7 L^15 z^3),d=P2(S^11 L^21 z^8),Y=P2(S^13 L^25 z^7),z=ceil(log2 L). Initial dimension10000 and design dimension100 are fixed; internal dimensions equal z. All header and field/matrix data are actual input bits; condenser fields are computed deterministically. No good scale, field, advice or witness is supplied externally. The supplied proof establishes a hard restriction at ONE fixed scale S0 for every sufficiently large integer N.
theorem: This fixed total language is in P, hence NP with empty witnesses, on every input header and field string. There exist absolute constants B>0,N0 such that for every integer actual length N>=N0, unconditionally in the pinned full B2 model, C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-B*(log2 N)^28*(log2(log2 N))^7. For the SAME family and every fixed epsilon>0, eventually C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-(log2 N)^28*(log2(log2 N))^(7+epsilon), and hence also4*N-(log2 N)^(28+epsilon) and4*N-N^epsilon. The proof fixes one actual header value S0, not per-length advice: exact loss is R(N)=4*P(N,S0)+8*k(N,S0), with P including the ENTIRE header and all construction bits and P=L+O(S0^7 L^15 z^5)=o(k). Existence of S0 is used only for hardness, while eligibility and all algorithms are fixed and compute every header. The supplied finite gate proof is4n-8d with all sharing and B2 tables.
